Chapter one

Our
Story

“We kept finding our way back to the same conversation.”

It started with a missed train

We met on a rainy Thursday when a delayed train left us standing beneath the same narrow awning. Jason offered the last dry spot and Anna offered half her umbrella when the platform finally opened. Coffee the next morning became a Saturday ritual, then a shared apartment full of records, plants and ambitious dinner plans.

Over six years, we have collected coastlines, inside jokes and a remarkable number of photographs with our eyes closed. Through every season, home has simply become wherever we are together. We cannot imagine beginning our next chapter without the people who helped shape the first.

The easiest yes

How He
Proposed

On the anniversary of that first coffee, Jason retraced their favorite walk through the city. At every corner, a friend held a note remembering a year they had shared. The final note waited beneath the old station clock. Anna read three words—“one more adventure?”—looked up, and found him on one knee.

21 December · One year to go
